note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after TestXFRMPortScopedBypassIsNeverStoredOnTheForwardPath, E8 tightening TestRFC4301ForwardedFragmentsRespectOperatorDisposition and E13 renaming reconcileForTest in rfc4301_fragment_boundary_integration_linux_test.go and rfc4301_fragment_forward_integration_linux_test.go. RFC 4301 Section 7.4: "All implementations MUST support stateful fragment checking to accommodate BYPASS traffic for which a non-trivial port range is specified." TestXFRMPortScopedBypassIsNeverStoredOnTheForwardPath verifies exact IN/OUT XFRM storage (never FWD, action ALLOW, positive control seen == installed). TestRFC4301CleartextFragmentsRespectOperatorDisposition (using reconcileForTest over reconcileSPDPolicies) verifies local IPv4 whole and fragmented cleartext BYPASS delivery vs DISCARD (XfrmInPolBlock) and PROTECT (XfrmInTmplMismatch) drops under unmatched discard. TestRFC4301ForwardedFragmentsRespectOperatorDisposition now strictly asserts exact seen.protected == 1 with XfrmOutPolBlock == 0 for both whole and fragmented PROTECT, exact XfrmOutPolBlock == 1 with zero cleartext/ESP for whole and fragmented DISCARD, and under unmatched discard verifies the projected FWD BYPASS gate passes whole and fragmented BYPASS while dropping a lone non-initial tail and unnamed-port fragments. TestRFC4301ForwardedIPv6FragmentsFollowAPortScopedBypass proves the IPv6 forward counterpart. Unit tests (TestPortScopedBypassNeverReachesTheForwardPath, TestPortScopedBypassForwardPathFollowsFragmentGathering, TestAnyPortBypassReachesTheForwardPath) confirm FWD projection is gated on K3 fragment gathering. Verdict stands.
